description.value: Ancora Ambleside is a multi-award-winning waterfront restaurant on the Ambleside shore of West Vancouver, serving Nikkei fusion cuisine that blends Peruvian and Japanese traditions with Pacific Northwest sustainable seafood. The dining room features high ceilings, sweeping panoramic views, a theatre-style open kitchen, and coastal-inspired décor by Vancouver's SmartDesign Group. It has appeared on Canada's 100 Best Restaurants list and earned repeated Wine Spectator Awards of Excellence.

address.value: 1351 Bellevue Avenue, West Vancouver BC V7T 2P9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Ancora Ambleside location at 1351 Bellevue Avenue, West Vancouver — a full-service waterfront restaurant with Peruvian-Japanese (Nikkei) cuisine. Phone (604.926.0287) and email (ambleside@ancoradining.com) match OSM exactly, but the postal code on the website (V7T 2P9) differs from OSM (V7T 0B5), and the website clearly identifies the city as West Vancouver while OSM lists the community as North Vancouver. Takeout is confirmed via a dedicated take-out page and Uber Eats/DoorDash listings; no bike parking, washroom, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the website clearly identifies the location as West Vancouver — the OSM record may be misassigned to the wrong municipality.
